race.description: Your Tickets To The Long Lunch On The Track 05/09 Mdn Hcp
race.comment: FLIRTATIOUS LASS (3) finished a bold runner-up at big odds when making her debut at Toowoomba and then failed to finish off her run after travelling wide throughout there 17 days ago. She has a big swing in her draw this time, and with the blinkers on for the first time, an immediate form reversal is expected. OLIVERJOHNNY (1) will find this easier than his first 2 starts, and he is also drawn closer in this time. Ash Butler sticks with him, and so do we. DESERT ANGEL (10) made ground fresh up in a handy 50K maiden field at Grafton nearly 3 weeks ago, and the extra 175m here is not problem She is right down in the weights after a 4kg claim, and she can figure in the top 3 this time. SONIC FLYER (5) made progress earlier in the year, and she has enough scope to pick up a maiden win at short notice. If she does not need the run, then she is well worth including in all combos. JELAILA (9) only battled at Goondiwindi, which can happen sometimes. Don't drop her yet.
